name: True Love: The Game
source:
Step into the lives of both the main male and female protagonist.

The male protagonist is one of the best MMORPG players out there. Unfortunately, he has no real-life experience with women – everything he knows comes from the internet. Will you help him finally change that?

The female protagonist, on the other hand, is a model student – quiet, well-behaved, always polite. But this summer, she’s decided to try something different. She wants to explore the more intimate side of life she’s always kept at a distance.

Two completely different people, bound together by a magical thread of fate. Their dreams begin to intertwine, leading to increasingly intense experiences – not just physical, but emotional as well.

Over time, everything starts to fall into place, and the bond between them deepens. You’ll get to know them… and maybe even feel something yourself.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/PandaGames25]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
走进男女主角的生活。

男主角是最好的MMORPG玩家之一。不幸的是，他没有与女性交往的现实经验——他所知道的一切都来自互联网。你最终会帮助他改变这一点吗？

而女主角则是一名模范生，安静、乖巧、彬彬有礼。但今年夏天，她决定尝试一些不同的东西。她想探索生活中她一直保持距离的更亲密的一面。

两个截然不同的人，被神奇的命运之线绑在了一起。他们的梦想开始交织在一起，带来越来越强烈的体验——不仅仅是身体上的，还有情感上的。

随着时间的推移，一切都开始步入正轨，他们之间的联系也加深了。你会逐渐了解他们……甚至可能自己也会有一些感受。
